name: Ice Stone

name: Beast Ball
description: Uma Pokébola projetada para lidar com criaturas de outros mundos. É extremamente eficaz contra Ultra Beasts, mas muito ineficiente contra qualquer outro Pokémon.

name: Big Malasada
description: Um doce grande e macio típico de Alola, muito apreciado por sua energia. Aumenta em +20 PWR movimentos do tipo Normal e concede imunidade a sono (exceto quando o próprio usuário usa Rest).

name: Red Nectar

name: Yellow Nectar

name: Purple Nectar

name: Protective Pads

name: Electric Seed
description: Uma semente energizada que vibra com eletricidade latente. Quando o terreno elétrico está ativo, desperta imediatamente seu poder, aumentando a Defesa em 1 estágio.

name: Psychic Seed
description: Uma semente impregnada por energia psíquica suave e concentrada. Ao entrar em contato com um terreno psíquico ativo, libera sua força oculta, aumentando a Defesa Especial em 1 estágio.

name: Misty Seed
description: Uma semente envolta por um véu etéreo de energia nebulosa. Sob a influência de um terreno de névoa, reage ao ambiente mágico ao redor, aumentando a Defesa Especial em 1 estágio.

name: Grassy Seed
description: Uma semente repleta de vitalidade natural. Quando ativada por um terreno de grama, absorve a energia viva do solo, aumentando a Defesa em 1 estágio.

name: N-Solarizer

name: N-Lunarizer
description: A machine to fuse Necrozma, which needs light, and Lunala.

name: Pewter Crunchies
description: Um snack crocante típico de Pewter, famoso por sua textura dura. Aumenta em +10 PWR movimentos do tipo Pedra e concede imunidade a envenenamento enquanto o efeito durar.

name: Pokémon Box Link
description: A device that allows you to access the Pokémon storage system. There are some places where it won’t work.

name: Fishing Rod
description: Use it by the water to fish up various kinds of Pokémon.

name: Sausages
description: Salsichas preparadas com carne macia e temperos leves. Ideais para pratos quentes, ganham sabor especial quando fervidas antes do consumo.

name: Bob’s Food Tin
description: Uma lata de alimento preparado segundo a receita tradicional de Bob. Seu sabor simples, porém marcante, a torna curiosamente popular na região de Galar.

name: Bach’s Food Tin
description: Uma conserva criada por Bach, reconhecida pelo tempero característico. Muito apreciada em Galar por seu gosto único e surpreendentemente agradável.

name: Tin of Beans
description: Uma lata de feijões cozidos lentamente. Ao serem aquecidos, liberam um sabor suave que combina bem com diversos tipos de refeição.

name: Bread
description: Pão fresco de aroma acolhedor e textura macia. Um acompanhamento versátil que harmoniza bem com quase qualquer preparação culinária.

name: Pasta
description: Massa simples feita de farinha e água, valorizada por sua versatilidade. Quando cozida, torna-se base para inúmeros pratos caseiros.

name: Mixed Mushrooms
description: Um conjunto variado de cogumelos de aroma terroso. Sua mistura equilibrada adiciona profundidade a pratos quentes e ensopados.

name: Smoke-Poke Tail
description: Cauda de Slowpoke naturalmente desprendida, de sabor suave e defumado. Tradicional em algumas cozinhas, é apreciada pelo toque delicado que oferece aos pratos.

name: Large Leek
description: Um alho-poró grande e excepcionalmente robusto. Valioso tanto em culinária de luxo quanto como item que aprimora as técnicas de Pokémon especializados nesse tipo de arma natural.

name: Fancy Apple
description: Uma maçã selecionada por sua forma impecável e brilho intenso. Doce e aromática, valoriza sobremesas e preparados de sabor refinado.

name: Brittle Bones
description: Ossos frágeis que, quando fervidos, liberam um caldo leve e cheio de umami. Usados para dar profundidade a sopas e preparações líquidas.

name: Pack of Potatoes
description: Um pacote de batatas frescas e nutritivas. Sua textura firme permite inúmeras formas de preparo, desde cozidos até assados.

name: Pungent Root
description: Raiz aromática de cheiro acentuado. Mesmo colhida de forma simples, adiciona um toque perfumado e único aos pratos que tempera.

name: Salad Mix
description: Mistura de folhas frescas e crocantes. Serve como base leve e versátil para saladas, oferecendo frescor imediato às refeições.

name: Fried Food
description: Petisco frito há algum tempo, agora levemente oleoso. Apesar disso, ainda carrega um sabor marcante típico de frituras.

name: Boiled Egg
description: Ovo cozido até atingir uma textura firme e agradável. Um ingrediente prático, utilizado para enriquecer pratos rápidos e caseiros.

name: Camping Gear
description: Everything you need to set up a tent and get cooking in a Wild Area or at a camping spot.

name: Rusted Sword
description: It is said that a hero used this sword to halt a terrible disaster in ancient times. But it’s grown rusty and worn.

name: Rusted Shield
description: It is said that a hero used this shield to halt a terrible disaster in ancient times. But it’s grown rusty and worn.

name: Fossilized Bird
description: Um fóssil que parece parte do corpo de um Pokémon aviário primitivo. Leve, porém rochoso, símbolo de criaturas ágeis de eras remotas.

name: Fossilized Fish
description: Um fóssil aquático repleto de minerais brilhantes. Mostra a silhueta de um peixe ancestral robusto.

name: Fossilized Drake
description: Fragmentos ósseos pesados que lembram um dragão bípede primitivo. Emana uma aura imponente mesmo petrificado.

name: Fossilized Dino
description: Um fóssil com características de um grande réptil jurássico. Cada rachadura conta a história de um gigante ancestral.

name: Strawberry Sweet
description: A strawberry-shaped sweet. When a Milcery holds this, it will spin around happily.

name: Love Sweet
description: A heart-shaped sweet. When a Milcery holds this, it spins around happily.

name: Berry Sweet
description: A berry-shaped sweet. When a Milcery holds this, it spins around happily.

name: Clover Sweet
description: A clover-shaped sweet. When a Milcery holds this, it spins around happily.

name: Flower Sweet
description: A flower-shaped sweet. When a Milcery holds this, it spins around happily.

name: Star Sweet
description: A star-shaped sweet. When a Milcery holds this, it spins around happily.

name: Ribbon Sweet
description: A ribbon-shaped sweet. When a Milcery holds this, it spins around happily.

name: Sweet Apple
description: Maçã doce e aromática, muito usada em pratos regionais e famosa por estimular evoluções mais suaves.

name: Tart Apple
description: Maçã intensamente azeda, apreciada em receitas rústicas e conhecida por despertar evoluções únicas.

name: Throat Spray
description: Raises Sp. Atk when a Pokémon uses a sound-based move.

name: Eject Pack
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When the holder’s stats are lowered, it will be switched out of battle.

name: Heavy-Duty Boots
description: These boots prevent the effects of traps set on the battlefield.

name: Blunder Policy
description: Raises Speed sharply when a Pokémon misses with a move because of accuracy.

name: Room Service
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. Lowers Speed when Trick Room takes effect.

name: Utility Umbrella
description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This sturdy umbrella protects the holder from the effects of rain and harsh sunlight.

name: Exp. Candy XS
description: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will grant a single Pokémon a very small amount of Exp. Points.

name: Exp. Candy S
description: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will grant a single Pokémon a small amount of Exp. Points.

name: Exp. Candy M
description: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will grant a single Pokémon a moderate amount of Exp. Points.

name: Exp. Candy L
description: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will grant a single Pokémon a large amount of Exp. Points.

name: Exp. Candy XL
description: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will grant a single Pokémon a very large amount of Exp. Points.

name: Dynamax Candy
description: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will raise the Dynamax Level of a single Pokémon by one. A higher level means higher HP when Dynamaxed.

name: Cracked Pot
description: A peculiar teapot that can make a certain species of Pokémon evolve. It may be cracked, but tea poured from it is delicious.

name: Chipped Pot
description: A peculiar teapot that can make a certain species of Pokémon evolve. It may be chipped, but tea poured from it is delicious.

name: Fruit Bunch
description: Conjunto de frutas doces e suculentas. Seu aroma tropical forte adiciona vivacidade e cor a diversas receitas.

name: Moomoo Cheese
description: Queijo cremoso feito com leite Moomoo. Ao derreter, traz riqueza e profundidade a pratos quentes, especialmente curries.

name: Spice Mix
description: Uma combinação equilibrada de especiarias aromáticas. Um toque pequeno já basta para transformar por completo o sabor de uma refeição.

name: Fresh Cream
description: Creme fresco e sedoso, perfeito para ser batido. Acrescentado a pratos picantes, oferece doçura e suavidade equilibrada.

name: Packaged Curry
description: Pacote de curry pré-preparado, prático e saboroso. Ideal para refeições rápidas sem perder o aroma tradicional da especiaria.

name: Coconut Milk
description: Leite extraído do coco maduro, de textura cremosa e sabor adocicado. Excelente para dar corpo e suavidade a pratos tropicais e ensopados.

name: Instant Noodles
description: Macarrão instantâneo de preparo rápido. Absorve bem temperos e caldos, servindo como base imediata para refeições simples e reconfortantes.

name: Precooked Burger
description: Hambúrguer pré-cozido pronto para uso. Uma opção segura e prática para quem precisa de um prato rápido e saboroso sem muito preparo.

name: Gigantamix
description: Uma especiaria misteriosa de aroma intenso. Mesmo em pequenas quantidades, transforma o sabor da refeição, produzindo um resultado marcante e memorável.

name: Catching Charm
description: Holding it is said to increase the chance of getting a critical catch. Curiously, the charm doesn’t shake much.

name: Max Honey
description: Honey that Dynamax Vespiquen produces. Adding this honey to Max Soup makes the taste very smooth. It also has the same effect as a Max Revive.

name: Max Mushrooms
description: Mushrooms that have the power of changing Dynamax forms. They boost all stats of a Pokémon during battle.

name: Galarica Twig
description: Um galho fino proveniente de uma espécie de árvore chamada Galarica, que cresce em áreas específicas da região de Galar. Possui fibras leves e resistentes, sendo um material especial usado na criação de certos acessórios.

name: Galarica Cuff
description: A cuff made from woven-together Galarica Twigs. Giving it to Galarian Slowpoke makes the Pokémon very happy.

name: Exp. Charm
description: A charm that increases the Exp. Points that Pokémon can get. A machine-like object is inside the charm.

name: Mark Charm
description: A mysterious and unique charm that increases the chance of finding a Pokémon with a mark.

name: Galarica Wreath
description: A wreath made from woven-together Galarica Twigs. Placing it on the head of a Galarian Slowpoke makes the Pokémon very happy.

name: Ability Patch
description: A patch that allows a Pokémon with a regular Ability to have a rare Ability.

name: Reins of Unity
description: Cords that shine when you hold them up to the light. The people of old times presented these to the King of Bountiful Harvests to express their gratitude.

name: Strange Ball
description: Uma Pokébola incomum vinda de uma realidade alternativa. Funciona como uma Pokébola comum, mas é estável ao capturar Pokémon de outros mundos ou dimensões.

name: Baguette
description: Um pão alongado de casca crocante e interior macio. Muito apreciado como base em pratos simples ou elaborados, acrescentando textura e sabor característico.

name: Mayonnaise
description: Um creme suave e espesso feito à base de óleo e ovos. Seu sabor delicado adiciona riqueza e uma textura aveludada a diversas preparações.

name: Ketchup
description: Um molho vermelho adocicado feito de tomates concentrados. Usado para realçar receitas com um toque familiar e marcante.

name: Mustard
description: Pasta aromática feita a partir de sementes de mostarda. Oferece um sabor forte e levemente picante que destaca qualquer prato.

name: Butter
description: Uma gordura cremosa de sabor rico. Usada para cozinhar ou finalizar pratos, adicionando aroma e maciez inconfundíveis.

name: Peanut Butter
description: Pasta espessa feita de amendoins moídos. Seu gosto intenso e levemente adocicado dá profundidade a receitas doces e salgadas.

name: Chili Sauce
description: Molho picante de tonalidade vibrante. Acrescenta calor e intensidade a pratos que pedem um toque mais ousado.

name: Salt
description: Cristais minerais puros usados para realçar o sabor de qualquer alimento. Essencial em praticamente todas as preparações culinárias.

name: Pepper
description: Grãos escuros moídos de aroma forte. Trazem um toque picante e perfumado que complementa inúmeros pratos.

name: Yogurt
description: Creme fermentado de sabor suave e refrescante. Utilizado para dar leveza e acidez equilibrada a misturas culinárias.

name: Whipped Cream
description: Creme batido até uma textura leve e aerada. Adiciona suavidade e doçura a sobremesas e pratos delicados.

name: Cream Cheese
description: Queijo cremoso e untuoso, de sabor suave e levemente ácido. Usado tanto como base quanto como complemento em preparos variados.

name: Jam
description: Doce espesso preparado com frutas cozidas e açúcar. Oferece sabor rico e frutado, perfeito para recheios e acompanhamentos.

name: Marmalade
description: Doce cítrico feito com cascas e polpa de frutas. Possui sabor distinto, equilibrando amargor e doçura de forma marcante.

name: Olive Oil
description: Óleo extraído de azeitonas maduras, de aroma frutado e textura suave. Muito usado para cozinhar, temperar e finalizar pratos.

name: Vinegar
description: Líquido ácido obtido por fermentação. Confere frescor e acidez equilibrada que transforma marinadas, molhos e temperos.

name: Sweet Herba Mystica
description: Uma erva rara de fragrância doce e envolvente. Muito valorizada por seu aroma único que eleva sobremesas e receitas delicadas.

name: Salty Herba Mystica
description: Erva rara de sabor salgado profundo. Aprecia-se sua capacidade de intensificar pratos encorpados com seu toque marcante.

name: Sour Herba Mystica
description: Erva de acidez vibrante e aroma penetrante. Usada para trazer vivacidade e contraste a combinações culinárias.

name: Bitter Herba Mystica
description: Erva de amargor pronunciado e cheiro herbal intenso. Ideal para pratos complexos que pedem um toque sofisticado.

name: Spicy Herba Mystica
description: Erva de ardência poderosa e aroma quente. Capaz de transformar receitas com seu calor intenso e sabor energético.

name: Lettuce
description: Folhas verdes crocantes e refrescantes. Usadas para adicionar leveza e textura a saladas e sanduíches.

name: Tomato
description: Fruto suculento de sabor equilibrado entre doce e ácido. Muito versátil em pratos frescos ou cozidos.

name: Cherry Tomatoes
description: Tomatinhos pequenos e intensamente doces. Excelente para dar cor e frescor imediato a qualquer preparação.

name: Cucumber
description: Vegetal fresco e aquoso, de sabor suave. Ideal para pratos frios que pedem crocância e leveza.

name: Pickle
description: Pepino curtido em tempero ácido e aromático. Acrescenta sabor forte e vibrante a pratos diversos.

name: Onion
description: Bulbo aromático de gosto marcante. Base fundamental de inúmeras receitas, adicionando profundidade ao sabor.

name: Red Onion
description: Cebola de coloração roxa e sabor mais adocicado. Usada para trazer cor e frescor a pratos frios e cozidos.

name: Green Bell Pepper
description: Pimentão verde de aroma herbal e sabor levemente amargo. Dá um toque vegetal fresco a muitas combinações.

name: Red Bell Pepper
description: Pimentão vermelho de polpa doce e vibrante. Utilizado para enriquecer pratos com cor e sabor intenso.

name: Yellow Bell Pepper
description: Pimentão amarelo de doçura equilibrada. Ideal para receitas que pedem suavidade e brilho visual.

name: Avocado
description: Fruto macio e cremoso, de sabor suave. Acrescenta textura rica e amanteigada a pratos variados.

name: Bacon
description: Tiras curadas e defumadas de sabor robusto. Utilizadas para dar crocância e intensidade a diversas receitas.

name: Ham
description: Carne suína curada de sabor suave e salgado. Comum em preparações rápidas, lanches e pratos leves.

name: Prosciutto
description: Presunto fino e curado lentamente. Possui sabor delicado e elegante, muito apreciado em receitas mais sofisticadas.

name: Chorizo
description: Linguiça vermelha condimentada com especiarias. Adiciona calor e aroma marcante a pratos de sabor forte.

name: Herbed Sausage

name: TM173 - Bullet Seed
description: Shoots 2 to 5 seeds in a row to strike the foe.

name: TM174 - Aerial Ace
description: An extremely speedy and unavoidable attack.

name: TM175 - Icicle Spear
description: Attacks the foe by firing 2 to 5 icicles in a row.

name: TM176 - Iron Defense
description: Hardens the body’s surface to sharply raise DEFENSE.

name: TM177 - Block
description: Blocks the foe’s way to prevent escape.

name: TM178 - Dragon Claw
description: Slashes the foe with sharp claws.

name: TM179 - Frenzy Plant
description: Powerful, but leaves the user immobile the next turn.

name: TM180 - Bulk Up
description: Bulks up the body to boost both ATTACK and DEFENSE.

name: TM181 - Bounce
description: Bounces up, then down the next turn. May paralyze.

name: TM182 - Mud Shot
description: Hurls mud at the foe and reduces SPEED.

name: TM183 - Poison Tail
description: Has a high critical-hit ratio. May also poison.

name: TM184 - Covet
description: Cutely begs to obtain an item held by the foe.

name: TM185 - Volt Tackle
description: A life-risking tackle that slightly hurts the user.

name: TM186 - Magical Leaf
description: Attacks with a strange leaf that cannot be evaded.

name: TM187 - Calm Mind
description: Raises SP. ATK and SP. DEF by focusing the mind.

name: TM188 - Leaf Blade
description: Slashes with a sharp leaf. High critical-hit ratio.

name: TM189 - Dragon Dance
description: A mystical dance that ups ATTACK and SPEED.

name: TM190 - Rock Blast
description: Hurls boulders at the foe 2 to 5 times in a row.

name: TM191 - Shock Wave
description: A fast and unavoidable electric attack.

name: TM192 - Water Pulse
description: Attacks with ultrasonic waves. May confuse the foe

name: TM193 - Roost
description: The user lands and rests its body. It restores the user’s HP by up to half of its max HP.

name: TM194 - Gravity
description: Gravity is intensified for five turns, making moves involving flying unusable and negating Levitation.

name: TM195 - Hammer Arm
description: The user swings and hits with its strong and heavy fist. It lowers the user’s Speed, however.

name: TM196 - Gyro Ball
description: The user tackles the foe with a high-speed spin. The slower the user, the greater the damage.

name: TM197 - Healing Wish
description: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its HP restored and status cured.

name: TM198 - Brine
description: If the foe’s HP is down to about half, this attack will hit with double the power.

name: TM199 - Natural Gift
description: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.

name: TM200 - Pluck
description: The user pecks the foe. If the foe is holding a Berry, the user plucks it and gains its effect.

name: TM201 - Tailwind
description: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that ups the Speed of all party Pokémon for three turns.

name: TM202 - Acupressure
description: The user applies pressure to stress points, sharply boosting one of its stats.

name: TM203 - U Turn
description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

name: TM204 - Close Combat
description: The user fights the foe in close without guarding itself. It also cuts the user’s Defense and Sp. Def.

name: TM205 - Payback
description: If the user can use this attack after the foe attacks, its power is doubled.

name: TM206 - Assurance
description: If the foe has already taken some damage in the same turn, this attack’s power is doubled.

name: TM207 - Embargo
description: It prevents the foe from using its held item. Its Trainer is also prevented from using items on it.

name: TM208 - Fling
description: The user flings its held item at the foe to attack. Its power and effects depend on the item.

name: TM209 - Gastro Acid
description: The user hurls up its stomach acids on the foe. The fluid eliminates the effect of the foe’s ability.

name: TM210 - Me First
description: The user tries to cut ahead of the foe to steal and use the foe’s intended move with greater power.

name: TM211 - Copycat
description: The user mimics the move used immediately before it. The move fails if no other move has been used yet.

name: TM212 - Power Swap
description: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Attack and Sp. Atk with the foe.

name: TM213 - Guard Swap
description: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Defense and Sp. Def with the foe.

name: TM214 - Last Resort
description: This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows in the battle.

name: TM215 - Worry Seed
description: A seed that causes worry is planted on the foe. It prevents sleep by making its ability Insomnia.

name: TM216 - Sucker Punch
description: This move enables the user to attack first. It fails if the foe is not readying an attack, however.

name: TM217 - Toxic Spikes
description: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the foe’s feet. They poison foes that switch into battle.

name: TM218 - Magnet Rise
description: The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for five turns.

name: TM219 - Flare Blitz
description: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the foe. The user sustains serious damage, too.

name: TM220 - Aura Sphere
description: The user looses a blast of aura power from deep within its body. This move is certain to hit.

name: TM221 - Rock Polish
description: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. It can sharply raise the Speed stat.

name: TM222 - Poison Jab
description: The foe is stabbed with a tentacle or arm steeped in poison. It may also poison the foe.

name: TM223 - Dark Pulse
description: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark thoughts. It may also make the target flinch.

name: TM224 - Night Slash
description: The user slashes the foe the instant an opportunity arises. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

name: TM225 - Aqua Tail
description: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.

name: TM226 - Seed Bomb
description: The user slams a barrage of hard- shelled seeds down on the foe from above.

name: TM227 - Air Slash
description: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. It may also make the target flinch.

name: TM228 - X Scissor
description: The user slashes at the foe by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.

name: TM229 - Bug Buzz
description: The user vibrates its wings to generate a damaging sound wave. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

name: TM230 - Dragon Pulse
description: The foe is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user’s gaping mouth.

name: TM231 - Power Gem
description: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.

name: TM232 - Drain Punch
description: An energy-draining punch. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

name: TM233 - Vacuum Wave
description: The user whirls its fists to send a wave of pure vacuum at the foe. This move always goes first.

name: TM234 - Focus Blast
description: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

name: TM235 - Energy Ball
description: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the foe. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

name: TM236 - Brave Bird
description: The user tucks in its wings and charges from a low altitude. The user also takes serious damage.

name: TM237 - Earth Power
description: The user makes the ground under the foe erupt with power. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

name: TM238 - Switcheroo
description: The user trades held items with the foe faster than the eye can follow.

name: TM239 - Giga Impact
description: The user charges at the foe using every bit of its power. The user must rest on the next turn.

name: TM240 - Nasty Plot
description: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. It sharply raises the user’s Sp. Atk.

name: TM241 - Bullet Punch
description: The user strikes with a tough punch as fast as a bullet. This move always goes first.

name: TM242 - Avalanche
description: An attack move that inflicts double the damage if the user has been hurt by the foe in the same turn.

name: TM243 - Shadow Claw
description: The user slashes with a sharp claw made from shadows. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

name: TM244 - Thunder Fang
description: The user bites with electrified fangs. It may also make the foe flinch or become paralyzed.

name: TM245 - Ice Fang
description: The user bites with cold-infused fangs. It may also make the foe flinch or freeze.

name: TM246 - Fire Fang
description: The user bites with flame-cloaked fangs. It may also make the foe flinch or sustain a burn.

name: TM247 - Psycho Cut
description: The user tears at the foe with blades formed by psychic power. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

name: TM248 - Zen Headbutt
description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and rams the foe. It may also make the target flinch.

name: TM249 - Flash Cannon
description: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it at once. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

name: TM250 - Rock Climb
description: A charging attack that may also leave the foe confused. It can also be used to scale rocky walls.

name: TM251 - Defog
description: Obstacles are moved, reducing the foe’s evasion stat. It can also be used to clear deep fog, etc.

name: TM252 - Trick Room
description: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

name: TM253 - Draco Meteor
description: Comets are summoned down from the sky. The attack’s recoil sharply reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

name: TM254 - Leaf Storm
description: A storm of sharp leaves is whipped up. The attack’s recoil sharply reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

name: TM255 - Power Whip
description: The user violently whirls its vines or tentacles to harshly lash the foe.

name: TM256 - Cross Poison
description: A slashing attack that may also leave the target poisoned. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

name: TM257 - Gunk Shot
description: The user shoots filthy garbage at the foe to attack. It may also poison the target.

name: TM258 - Iron Head
description: The foe slams the target with its steel-hard head. It may also make the target flinch.

name: TM259 - Stone Edge
description: The user stabs the foe with a sharpened stone. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

name: TM260 - Captivate
description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe is charmed into sharply lowering its Sp. Atk stat.

name: TM261 - Stealth Rock
description: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the foe. The trap hurts foes that switch into battle.

name: TM262 - Grass Knot
description: The user snares the foe with grass and trips it. The heavier the foe, the greater the damage.

name: TM263 - Bug Bite
description: The user bites the foe. If the foe is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

name: TM264 - Charge Beam
description: The user fires a concentrated bundle of electricity. It may also raise the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

name: TM265 - Ominous Wind
description: The user creates a gust of repulsive wind. It may also raise all the user’s stats at once.

name: TM266 - Hone Claws
description: The user sharpens its claws to boost its Attack stat and accuracy.

name: TM267 - Wide Guard
description: The user and its allies are protected from wide-ranging attacks for one turn. If used in succession, its chance of failing rises.

name: TM268 - Wonder Room
description: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon’s Defense and Sp. Def stats are swapped for five turns.

name: TM269 - Psyshock
description: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.

name: TM270 - Venoshock
description: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid. Its power is doubled if the target is poisoned.

name: TM271 - Rage Powder
description: The user scatters a cloud of irritating powder to draw attention to itself. Opponents aim only at the user.

name: TM272 - Telekinesis
description: The user makes the target float with its psychic power. The target is easier to hit for three turns.

name: TM273 - Magic Room
description: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon’s held items lose their effects for five turns.

name: TM274 - Smack Down
description: The user throws a stone or projectile to attack an opponent. A flying Pokémon will fall to the ground when hit.

name: TM275 - Sludge Wave
description: It swamps the area around the user with a giant sludge wave. It may also poison those hit.

name: TM276 - Heavy Slam
description: The user slams into the target with its heavy body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater its damage.

name: TM277 - Electro Ball
description: The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The faster the user is than the target, the greater the damage.

name: TM278 - Flame Charge
description: The user cloaks itself with flame and attacks. Building up more power, it raises the user’s Speed stat.

name: TM279 - Low Sweep
description: The user attacks the target’s legs swiftly, reducing the target’s Speed stat.

name: TM280 - Acid Spray
description: The user spits fluid that works to melt the target. This harshly reduces the target’s Sp. Def stat.

name: TM281 - Foul Play
description: The user turns the target’s power against it. The higher the target’s Attack stat, the greater the damage.

name: TM282 - After You
description: The user helps the target and makes it use its move right after the user.

name: TM283 - Round
description: The user attacks the target with a song. Others can join in the Round and make the attack do greater damage.

name: TM284 - Echoed Voice
description: The user attacks the target with an echoing voice. If this move is used every turn, it does greater damage.

name: TM285 - Stored Power
description: The user attacks the target with stored power. The more the user’s stats are raised, the greater the damage.

name: TM286 - Quick Guard
description: The user protects itself and its allies from priority moves. If used in succession, its chance of failing rises.

name: TM287 - Ally Switch
description: The user teleports using a strange power and switches its place with one of its allies.

name: TM288 - Scald
description: The user shoots boiling hot water at its target. It may also leave the target with a burn.

name: TM289 - Hex
description: This relentless attack does massive damage to a target affected by status problems.

name: TM290 - Sky Drop
description: The user takes the target into the sky, then drops it during the next turn. The target cannot attack while in the sky.

name: TM291 - Incinerate
description: The user attacks the target with fire. If the target is holding a Berry, the Berry becomes burnt up and unusable.

name: TM292 - Quash
description: The user suppresses the target and makes its move go last.

name: TM293 - Acrobatics
description: The user nimbly strikes the target. If the user is not holding an item, this attack inflicts massive damage.

name: TM294 - Retaliate
description: The user gets revenge for a fainted ally. If an ally fainted in the previous turn, this attack’s damage increases.

name: TM295 - Final Gambit
description: The user risks everything to attack its target. The user faints but does damage equal to the user’s HP.

name: TM296 - Bestow
description: The user passes its held item to the target when the target isn’t holding an item.

name: TM297 - Water Pledge
description: A column of water strikes the target. When combined with its fire equivalent, the damage increases and a rainbow appears.

name: TM298 - Fire Pledge
description: A column of fire hits opposing Pokémon. When used with its Grass equivalent, its damage increases into a vast sea of fire.

name: TM299 - Grass Pledge
description: A column of grass hits opposing Pokémon. When used with its water equivalent, its damage increases into a vast swamp.

name: TM300 - Volt Switch
description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

name: TM301 - Struggle Bug
description: While resisting, the user attacks the opposing Pokémon. The targets’ Sp. Atk stat is reduced.

name: TM302 - Bulldoze
description: The user stomps down on the ground and attacks everything in the area. Hit Pokémon’s Speed stat is reduced.

name: TM303 - Frost Breath
description: The user blows a cold breath on the target. This attack always results in a critical hit.

name: TM304 - Dragon Tail
description: The user knocks away the target and drags out another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

name: TM305 - Work Up
description: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats increase.

name: TM306 - Electroweb
description: The user captures and attacks opposing Pokémon by using an electric net. It reduces the targets’ Speed stat.

name: TM307 - Wild Charge
description: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target. It also damages the user a little.

name: TM308 - Drill Run
description: The user crashes into its target while rotating its body like a drill. Critical hits land more easily.

name: TM309 - Dual Chop
description: The user attacks its target by hitting it with brutal strikes. The target is hit twice in a row.

name: TM310 - Razor Shell
description: The user cuts its target with sharp shells. This attack may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

name: TM311 - Heat Crash
description: The user slams its target with its flame- covered body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the damage.

name: TM312 - Hurricane
description: The user attacks by wrapping its opponent in a fierce wind that flies up into the sky. It may also confuse the target.

name: TM313 - Snarl
description: The user yells as if it is ranting about something, making the target’s Sp. Atk stat decrease.

name: TM314 - Phantom Force
description: The user vanishes somewhere, then strikes the target on the next turn. This move hits even if the target protects itself.

name: TM315 - Petal Blizzard
description: The user stirs up a violent petal blizzard and attacks everything around it.

name: TM316 - Disarming Voice
description: Letting out a charming cry, the user does emotional damage to opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.

name: TM317 - Draining Kiss
description: The user steals the target’s energy with a kiss. The user’s HP is restored by over half of the damage taken by the target.

name: TM318 - Grassy Terrain
description: The user turns the ground under everyone’s feet to grass for five turns. This restores the HP of Pokémon on the ground a little every turn.

name: TM319 - Misty Terrain
description: The user covers the ground under everyone’s feet with mist for five turns. This protects Pokémon on the ground from status conditions.

name: TM320 - Play Rough
description: The user plays rough with the target and attacks it. This may also lower the target’s Attack stat.

name: TM321 - Moonblast
description: Borrowing the power of the moon, the user attacks the target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

name: TM322 - Boomburst
description: The user attacks everything around it with the destructive power of a terrible, explosive sound.

name: TM323 - Confide
description: The user tells the target a secret, and the target loses its ability to concentrate. This lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

name: TM324 - Mystical Fire
description: The user attacks by breathing a special, hot fire. This also lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

name: TM325 - Eerie Impulse
description: The user’s body generates an eerie impulse. Exposing the target to it harshly lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

name: TM326 - Venom Drench
description: Opposing Pokémon are drenched in an odd poisonous liquid. This lowers the Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats of a poisoned target.

name: TM327 - Electric Terrain
description: The user electrifies the ground under everyone’s feet for five turns. Pokémon on the ground no longer fall asleep.

name: TM328 - Dazzling Gleam
description: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.

name: TM329 - Baby Doll Eyes
description: The user stares at the target with its baby-doll eyes, which lowers its Attack stat. This move always goes first.

name: TM330 - Infestation
description: The target is infested and attacked for four to five turns. The target can’t flee during this time.

name: TM331 - Power Up Punch
description: Striking opponents over and over makes the user’s fists harder. Hitting a target raises the Attack stat.

name: TM332 - Darkest Lariat
description: The user swings both arms and hits the target. The target’s stat changes don’t affect this attack’s damage.

name: TM333 - High Horsepower
description: The user fiercely attacks the target using its entire body.

name: TM334 - Solar Blade
description: In this two-turn attack, the user gathers light and fills a blade with the light’s energy, attacking the target on the next turn.

name: TM335 - Laser Focus
description: The user concentrates intensely. The attack on the next turn always results in a critical hit.

name: TM336 - Throat Chop
description: The user attacks the target’s throat, and the resultant suffering prevents the target from using moves that emit sound for two turns.

name: TM337 - Pollen Puff
description: The user attacks the enemy with a pollen puff that explodes. If the target is an ally, it gives the ally a pollen puff that restores its HP instead.

name: TM338 - Psychic Terrain
description: This protects Pokémon on the ground from priority moves and powers up Psychic-type moves for five turns.

name: TM339 - Lunge
description: The user makes a lunge at the target, attacking with full force. This also lowers the target’s Attack stat.

name: TM340 - Speed Swap
description: The user exchanges Speed stats with the target.

name: TM341 - Smart Strike
description: The user stabs the target with a sharp horn. This attack never misses.

name: TM342 - Brutal Swing
description: The user swings its body around violently to inflict damage on everything in its vicinity.

name: TM343 - Aurora Veil
description: This move reduces damage from physical and special moves for five turns. This can be used only in a hailstorm.

name: TM344 - Psychic Fangs
description: The user bites the target with its psychic capabilities. This can also destroy Light Screen and Reflect.

name: TM345 - Stomping Tantrum
description: Driven by frustration, the user attacks the target. If the user’s previous move has failed, the power of this move doubles.

name: TM346 - Liquidation
description: The user slams into the target using a full-force blast of water. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

name: TM347 - Body Press
description: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The higher the user’s Defense, the more damage it can inflict on the target.

name: TM348 - Breaking Swipe
description: The user swings its tough tail wildly and attacks opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Attack stats.

name: TM349 - Steel Beam
description: The user fires a beam of steel that it collected from its entire body. This also damages the user.

name: TM350 - Expanding Force
description: The user attacks the target with its psychic power. This move’s power goes up and damages all opposing Pokémon on Psychic Terrain.

name: TM351 - Steel Roller
description: The user attacks while destroying the terrain. This move fails when the ground hasn’t turned into a terrain.

name: TM352 - Scale Shot
description: The user attacks by shooting scales two to five times in a row. This move boosts the user’s Speed stat but lowers its Defense stat.

name: TM353 - Meteor Beam
description: In this two-turn attack, the user gathers space power and boosts its Sp. Atk stat, then attacks the target on the next turn.

name: TM354 - Misty Explosion
description: The user attacks everything around it and faints upon using this move. This move’s power is increased on Misty Terrain.

name: TM355 - Grassy Glide
description: Gliding on the ground, the user attacks the target. This move always goes first on Grassy Terrain.

name: TM356 - Rising Voltage
description: The user attacks with electric voltage rising from the ground. This move’s power doubles when the target is on Electric Terrain.

name: TM357 - Skitter Smack
description: The user skitters behind the target to attack. This also lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

name: TM358 - Burning Jealousy
description: The user attacks with energy from jealousy. This leaves all opposing Pokémon that have had their stats boosted during the turn with a burn.

name: TM359 - Lash Out
description: The user lashes out to vent its frustration toward the target. If the user’s stats were lowered during this turn, the power of this move is doubled.

name: TM360 - Poltergeist
description: The user attacks the target by controlling the target’s item. The move fails if the target doesn’t have an item.

name: TM361 - Corrosive Gas
description: The user surrounds everything around it with highly acidic gas and melts away items they hold.

name: TM362 - Coaching
description: The user properly coaches its ally Pokémon, boosting their Attack and Defense stats.

name: TM363 - Flip Turn
description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

name: TM364 - Triple Axel
description: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successful hit.

name: TM365 - Dual Wingbeat
description: The user slams the target with its wings. The target is hit twice in a row.

name: TM366 - Scorching Sands
description: The user throws scorching sand at the target to attack. This may also leave the target with a burn.

name: TM367 - Ice Spinner
description: The user covers its feet in thin ice and twirls around, slamming into the target. This move's spinning motion also destroys the terrain.

name: TM368 - Snowscape
description: The user summons a snowstorm lasting five turns. This boosts the Defense stats of Ice types.

name: TM369 - Pounce
description: The user attacks by pouncing on the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.

name: TM370 - Chilling Water
description: The user attacks the target by showering it with water that's so cold it saps the target's power. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.

name: TM371 - Hard Press
description: The target is crushed with an arm, a claw, or the like to inflict damage. The more HP the target has left, the greater the move's power.

name: TM372 - Dragon Cheer
description: The user raises its allies’ morale with a draconic cry so that their future attacks have a heightened chance of landing critical hits. This rouses Dragon types more.

name: TM373 - Alluring Voice
description: The user attacks the target using its angelic voice. This also confuses the target if its stats have been boosted during the turn.

name: TM374 - Temper Flare
description: Spurred by desperation, the user attacks the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's previous move failed.

name: TM375 - Supercell Slam
description: The user electrifies its body and drops onto the target to inflict damage. If this move misses, the user takes damage instead.

name: TM376 - Psychic Noise
description: The user attacks the target with unpleasant sound waves. For two turns, the target is prevented from recovering HP through moves, Abilities, or held items.

name: TM377 - Upper Hand
description: The user reacts to the target's movement and strikes with the heel of its palm, making the target flinch. This move fails if the target is not readying a priority move.
